text:
elaine: FYI I'm draining 3 nodes in eu-west1-gpu03. Seeing bursts of ECC/Xid errors and perf jitter. Suspect two flaky H100s. Starting replacement workflow, but we need to reconcile serials and pick a cross-dock route to avoid a week+ customs delay.

vik: which nodes + serials? can you paste the list so I can open vendor tickets?

elaine: copy below (pulled from /opt/inventory/last-scan.log):
```
node-gpu-eu-west1-03a: GPU#0 S/N: SN-H100-4821A, GPU#1 S/N: SN-H100-4821B
node-gpu-eu-west1-03b: GPU#2 S/N: SN-H100-4910C
node-gpu-eu-west1-03c: GPU#0 S/N: SN-H100-4821A  <-- dup serial reappeared in DB, needs reconciliation
```

cory: whoa duplicate serial on 03a/03c. that's the manifest merge bug we saw last quarter. may be DB stale + chassis swap. pls run this to get chassis asset tags: `ssh ops@node-gpu-eu-west1-03c "cat /sys/class/dmi/id/board_serial"`

elaine: ran it, chassis tag is CHS-2034-GB, firmware looks current. I also grabbed the kernel logs for the bursts: 
```
[ 1023.412] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 1023.423] ecc: corrected error at 0x7ff10
[ 1050.112] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 13, GPU fault
```

matt: can we avoid a full depot swap? do we have spares in FRA depot or do we need cross-ship from NL?

elaine: nearest spare pool shows two H100s in FRA-DC2, but the SLA for eu-west1 is 24h and FRA to our colo is usually same-day only if we use cross-dock. If customs flags it, could be 4-6 days. opsbot can create a cross-dock label if we tag as "expedite".

opsbot: created provisional manifest MAN-177642, awaiting final serial confirmation. Shipping option: FRA-DC2 -> eu-west1-crossdock hub -> on-site tech pickup. ETA best-case 18h, worst-case 72h.

vik: i'm opening vendor tickets and attaching the logs. vendor needs chassis + GPU serials and manifest. Please confirm the final serial list (fix dup) before I send.

elaine: confirmed final list after physical check on 03c: the GPU in 03c is actually SN-H100-4999D (DB stale). Final replace list: SN-H100-4821A, SN-H100-4910C, SN-H100-4999D.

rma-bot: RMA created: RMA#R-2026-4457 for SN-H100-4821A, RMA#R-2026-4458 for SN-H100-4910C, RMA#R-2026-4459 for SN-H100-4999D. Expected vendor pickup window 2 business days. Attachments: logs + kernel dumps.

cory: please note: tag tickets with "crossdock:eu-west1" and include manifest MAN-177642. also set priority: p1 if more than 2 nodes degraded.

matt: i'll reserve FRA spare pair for these RMAs and set a hold so they don't get allocated to a CI job. also creating a temporary scheduler pool to avoid scheduling on the drained nodes.

elaine: thanks. next steps: 1) vik sends vendor tickets with final serials & logs, 2) opsbot finalize expedite label if vendor confirms cross-dock, 3) matt marks spares held in inventory, 4) i'll monitor ECC counters and uncordon nodes when replacements arrive.

vik: on it. ping me if vendor asks for any additional telemetry. :thumbsup:
